thread:
Nina R.: Quick UX catch in the Models -> Details panel: the inline docs panel shows heading 'Model Name' but the API docs and CLI use `model_id`. Customers are confused which string to paste.

Evan T.: Seen a support case. We should make the in-product docs panel explicitly map terms. Small change: add a tiny table 'UI label -> API field'.

Priya S.: Agree. Also the in-product docs link text currently says 'Docs' which is not descriptive for screen readers. Change to 'Learn about model identifiers (opens docs)'.

Nina R.: Good call. Accessibility note: the in-product panel should have role="dialog" and a heading level for screen readers. Priya, can you draft the copy? Evan, can you add the mapping table in docs?

Priya S.: Draft copy: "Model display name — friendly label shown in the console. API name: `model_id` (use in requests). See mapping table in docs." Keep it one-liner.

Evan T.: I'll add a short anchor /docs/console/models#id-mapping and a 2-row table. Will also add an alias note for the CLI help. Pinging docs-bot to create PR.

docs-bot: PR opened by @evant: https://gh.internal/redwood/docs/pull/488 — adds anchor and mapping table.

Nina R.: Dev notes: please ensure the inline link has an accessible name and visible focus. Also bump the helper text contrast to meet AA at 14px.

Evan T.: Noted. I'll coordinate with frontend to ship the helper copy + link. Minimal CSS tweak for focus: `.help-link:focus { outline: 3px solid #0b66d0; }`. Estimate 1.5 dev-hours.

Priya S.: I'll update the in-product panel copy once the docs anchor exists.

Nina R.: Plan: ship helper copy + descriptive link this sprint; revisit a full label rename only if support continues to spike. Owners: Priya (copy), Evan (docs + link), FE (implementation).

Evan T.: Thanks — will follow up with PRs/links.
